=============================================================
 LionClient Redesigned - installation
-------------------------------------------------------------
 1. In this folder, double-click BUILD.BAT (or open Command
    Prompt here and run:  BUILD.BAT)
 2. The batch file will compile the UI framework + bootstrap
    stubs and produce client-patched.jar.
 3. Put client-patched.jar into your mods/ folder (Forge/
    Fabric/LabyMod) or run it standalone with
        java -jar client-patched.jar
 Press RIGHT_SHIFT in-game to open the new ClickGUI.
=============================================================
